coverage_decision: One complete extraction pass was used. The source is 14 article pages plus a front infographic and is dense but remains reviewable without semantic splitting. References were extracted separately and not atomized.
omissions: Pure bibliography entries were excluded from ATOM extraction and placed in the reference task queue.
The online supplementary file was not present in the supplied source packet.
source_integrity_flags: Figure 1 uses mg/mmol around a sentence that prints a UACR threshold as 20 mg/mol.
Finerenone dose prose overlaps at eGFR 60 mL/min/1.73 m2, whereas Figure 5 separates the 10 mg range as >25 to <60 and the 20 mg range as >=60.

Figure 5 displays an albuminuria >=200 mg/g criterion alongside eGFR >=20 for the SGLT2 inhibitor branch, while nearby prose recommends SGLT2 inhibitor treatment at eGFR >=20 without that albuminuria requirement.
